ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hevalo uploads the photos you choose as your profile picture, a group’s picture, a meme or a post.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hevalo records your voice when you tap record, to post a voice note or to play your speaking exercise back to you.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Hevalo reads how you tilt and turn your phone so that the deer on the screen moves with you, and keeps none of it.
